title: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice
seoTitle: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: One-pot saffron rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, and peas
subtitle: One-pot saffron rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, and peas
description: Chicken thighs and chorizo cook with bomba or short-grain rice, saffron, bell pepper, and peas into a fragrant one-pot crew dinner.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Use kosher salt as listed — measure each before heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch chicken. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Bloom saffron
steps.instruction: Steep saffron in warm broth 10 minutes until liquid turns golden and smells distinctly floral and earthy. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Crisp chorizo and brown chicken
steps.instruction: Cook chorizo in Dutch oven until fat renders and edges crisp. Remove. Brown chicken thighs in chorizo fat 4 minutes per side until golden.

steps.title: Build rice base
steps.instruction: Sauté onion and pepper 5 minutes. Add garlic, paprika, and rice. Toast 2 minutes until rice edges look translucent and smell nutty.

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.instruction: Add saffron broth, nest chicken and chorizo on top. Simmer covered 25–30 minutes without stirring until rice absorbs liquid and is tender. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 8 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Add peas and rest
steps.instruction: Stir in peas off heat, cover 5 minutes. Rice should be fluffy with slight socarrat crust at bottom if heat was even. Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a call — never serve picked-over pans to late crew. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Final quality check before service
steps.instruction: Walk the line once before opening service for Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice — confirm hotel pans are labeled, backup trays are in the 200°F oven, and thermometers are calibrated. Rookies should ask a senior cook to spot-check the first portion.

proTips: Wide pot is essential—deep narrow pots cook unevenly.
Lemon wedges at the line brighten rich chorizo fat.
Substitute andouille if Spanish chorizo unavailable—adjust salt.
tonightSpread: Simple green salad with sherry vinaigrette.
leftovers: Reheat covered with splash of broth to restore moisture.
Arancini-style balls from leftover rice—deep fry or bake.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Bold Spanish flavors feel like a special occasion. One pot means one cleanup after a long shift.
mealPrepNotes: Bloom saffron in warm broth 10 minutes before cooking. Use wide Dutch oven for even rice. Station: Do not stir rice after initial mix—stirring releases starch and makes mush. Station: Crisp chorizo first and reserve fat for browning chicken. Station: Rest pot 5 minutes covered off heat before serving for fluffy rice.
